description: Land Title Settlement Department - Moratuwella Moratuwa D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520214
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to a specific parcel of land (Parcel No. 81, Block 04) with detailed land particulars including owner information, extent, nature of title, and encumbrances. This falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land registration and property ownership matters.
